storyInfo: Rhodes Island reaches an agreement with Witte, Chairman of the Ursine State Council, and proceeds to Zelgrad in search of the Sarcophagus. In Zelgrad, a washerwoman finds a strange dust that she suspects is associated with her sister's strange illness.

attributes.options: Hff... brr...;It's cold...

attributes.content: Are you still cold, Doctor? I should've reminded you to bring heavier clothes.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Amiya clutches your fingertips. Her palm is cold too.
Hang in there for a while. Things will be better in Tsarevgrad.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: I thought this would be another solo audience.;I thought the Tsar would be more wary of us.

attributes.content: On the contrary, His Imperial Majesty was very impressed by Rhodes Island's feats in the Far North. He is eager to see you.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Especially after hearing that the leader of Rhodes Island is so young.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I didn't do very much...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Now is not the time for humility. Make the most of the good first impression—it can only be a good thing for the meeting.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: There are a few things about Grypherburg that I must communicate before we meet His Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: First... I'm sure you're not oblivious as to why the Tsar has chosen to grant you an audience.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: While His Majesty is known for his benevolence—;He would not give us access to the Sarcophagus for no reason.

attributes.content: You want the secrets of the Sarcophagus. So do we.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: We hope that this meeting will result in mutually beneficial cooperation.
attributes.name: Eloysius
Eloysius
attributes.content: You understand the most pressing matter facing Ursus...

attributes.name: Eloysius
attributes.content: Or at the very least, Grypherburg.

It has been two months since the Fourth Army began pressing toward Grypherburg. Now they remain in a tense standoff against the Second Army along the eastern shore of Lake Neva, with the occasional skirmish.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: They have not gone any further for now, but we can ill-afford to be optimistic.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: They continue to petition the State Council, demanding full support for the war that they intend to start.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: Most curious.
If the Fourth Army's intention is to start a war of conquest—;They should be on the borders of Ursus, not the outskirts of Grypherburg.

attributes.content: Hah... everyone knows what these traitors are planning. They continue their despicable attacks on the Council.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: There was an attempt on Chairman Witte's life the day after the Fourth Army's First Division was routed. The assassin's methods bore clear associations with those of the Fourth Army.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Yet in the face of such provocation, the Royal Guard somehow failed to capture or kill the assassin.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: There is also reason to believe that the assassin's accomplice, or accomplices, remain at large in the city.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: The Fourth Army is only the most immediate issue.;At the end of the day, Ursus must confront the reality of ore exhaustion.

attributes.content: Exactly. Most see two paths before the empire, war or peace, yet neither is sufficiently convincing to everyone.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: His Imperial Majesty places his hopes in the Sarcophagus, currently under the First Army's control.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: A breakthrough in this direction may represent the empire's last hope for a solution, absurd as it may sound.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Even so...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: Research into the Sarcophagus is not going smoothly.;The Council faces issues beyond research progress.
We were not invited as scholars.;We're here at the invitation of the Council, not the First Army.

attributes.content: Astute as always, Dr. {@nickname}.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: However, I would recommend against such overt astuteness during your audience with the Tsar.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It appears that the First Army is indeed hiding something... though it's better for you to hear from His Imperial Majesty himself.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: What do you think of the Tsar?

attributes.content: Even in a private setting like this, such a question is bound to raise suspicions.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: I just want to hear your thoughts.;I just want to be prepared.

attributes.content: You must have heard rumors about him from various channels. It's not my place to try to change opinions. All I can do is answer truthfully.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: If there is anyone in Ursus who will fight to the bitter end for her, it is His Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: For he has nothing, save Ursus.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...Off-limits...
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: This place is off-limits! Go away!
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: Please, sir, I'm not Infected! The new pass—see here, the pass! We bought it, we're law-abiding citizens...
attributes.name: Worried Citizen

attributes.content: We must deliver these goods in time! The nobles won't take them otherwise, even if they're unspoiled, and we'll be ruined!
attributes.name: Worried Citizen

attributes.content: We can't afford heat anymore, and our child is sick in bed... please, have mercy and let us pass—
attributes.name: Lamenting Citizen

attributes.content: Tsarevgrad Raion is currently under lockdown. Not even a pass made of gold will buy you passage.
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: Take your things and leave. An announcement will be made once the lockdown is lifted.
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: Is that a roadblock?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Stay in the vehicle. I'll check it out.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Didn't you hear me? This place is off-limits—
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: Zdravstvuyte.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: (Salutes)
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: What do you need, ma'am?
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: His Imperial Majesty wishes to meet these good people.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Tsarevgrad Raion is on lockdown. Even deliveries of necessities must be met by someone from inside.
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: By order of the Tsar.
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: You're doing your duty, I understand.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: But I'm curious, what do you do when His Imperial Majesty's orders contradict themselves?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Because I'm operating by order of the Tsar myself. In fact, I have his edict right here.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The young Imperial Guard unrolls a piece of paper with a bright red seal on the bottom corner.
It is the Tsar's administrative seal.
I understand. We can wait a little while, if there is some difficulty.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'm afraid waiting won't do any good, ma'am. The situation is unlikely to change until the culprit is caught.
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: Eloysius fights her urge to roll her eyes. She puts the edict back, places her hand on her sword hilt, and straightens her back.
She looks up again, her expression completely changed.
The Grypherburg Police are under the jurisdiction of the Ursus Guard. You have people inside Tsarevgrad.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: All you need to do is inform your commander that His Imperial Majesty's guests have arrived. The rest is no longer your concern.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: But—
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: 'Lieutenant Eloysius Vasilyevna Gorchekova, Imperial Guard Tsar's Battalion, accepts all responsibility for carrying out His Imperial Majesty's orders and consents to all inspections.'
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Pass that message to your commander.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Can you remember the whole thing?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...Yes, ma'am.
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: Please wait here for a moment.
attributes.name: Police Officer

attributes.content: One more thing.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The couple hauling the goods over there, they are with us too.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The items are meant for the Tsar. You may include them in your report.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Done.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The road's not open?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's open, but only for us.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Let's not waste the opportunity.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Enter.
attributes.name: Voice from Inside

attributes.content: Please wait here with the guests, Lieutenant Gorchekova.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: Thank you.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You look around as the servant departs.
The room's furnishing is minimalistic compared to the luxury that you saw on your way here, but its owner's position of authority is obvious.
The curtains are closed even during the day, electric lights shine brightly, documents are stacked up on a cart, and the corners of the table have been repaired with gold.

attributes.options: The office seems to be in frequent use.;You brought us in here directly?

attributes.content: How can you tell?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: There are multiple rooms with identical furnishings in the Amber Palace, as a safety measure. This is just one of them.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You should not make blind guesses.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What else did you think we need?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: These may be unusual times, but nothing opens doors like one's rank in Tsarevgrad, even without all the medals on my chest.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The only people allowed to access this area are the Tsar, his most trusted ministers, and people who have been granted special permission.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You should therefore be respectful. Conversation is permitted, but I would refrain from commentary, if I were you.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: I meant no offense.

attributes.content: I understand.
attributes.name: Eloysius
Eloysius
attributes.content: Just keep your patience, as you did last time, until His Imperial Majesty is finished...

attributes.name: Eloysius
attributes.content: with the things that are troubling him right now.
—Chairman?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I thought Your High Excellency was still recovering at home—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'm here on His Imperial Majesty's behalf. He has urgent matters to attend to.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Your work here is done, lieutenant. I would meet with our guests privately.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I've spoken to your father. He is concerned about how busy you have been lately, and hopes that you come home once in a while, if you could.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Your High Excellency's concern is appreciated, Chairman Witte.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I will take my leave.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The young woman claps her heels together in a military salute, then turns and departs.
The chairman watches her leave, only turning around once the door is fully closed.

attributes.options: Greetings, Chairman Witte.;Your reputation precedes you, Chairman Witte.

attributes.content: Greetings, guests from afar. Thank you for accepting our invitation.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I see we have learned of each other, in different ways.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Please, take a seat.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: There is little time for pleasantries. Let us be frank and honest with each other.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty, it is my honor to report the progress that the First Army has made on Project Zero.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Her High Excellency the Marshal understands that you are much troubled by matters of state and the traitors' movements. I hope the news I bring will do something to soothe these troubles.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: ...Where is Marshal Buterina?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: She remains in her domain.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: She's supervising Project Zero, and she should be the one reporting to me.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Why are you here in her stead?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I apologize, Your Imperial Majesty, I should have explained.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: The Marshal's son, Anatoliy, was attacked a few days ago, and remains in serious condition. Her High Excellency has no choice but to remain behind, both to punish the perpetrators, and to prevent further instability.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: After all, we are not like the Fourth Army; no hint of rebellion is permitted, whether internal or external.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Why have I not been informed?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: It is the Marshal's private family matter, after all.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Now, if you have no other questions, I will continue my report.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: How could you speak to the Tsar like this? You insolent—
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: I am simply stating the facts, yet you make a serious accusation. I am fully able to take responsibility for my words. Can you say the same?
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Why you—!
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: That will do... continue, Kapitan.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Grypherburg has already committed tremendous resources to Project Zero. If there is no material progress...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: There will be consequences.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Rest assured, you will not be disappointed.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Before we begin, allow me to satisfy my curiosity.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I understand Rhodes Island came a long way to the Far North, rescuing the Infected miners there.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: May I ask why?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Rhodes Island is a medical concern, and our mission is to combat Oripathy. We are committed to providing treatment for any Oripathy sufferer who needs it.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Does the Empire of Ursus feel the need to question every act of kindness towards the Infected?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You tug the corner of Amiya's skirt.
...Infected, Cautus, leader of Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You are known by the mononym Amiya, correct?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Understand that I am not seeking to interrogate Rhodes Island on your aims.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Lieutenant Gorchekova thinks highly of you. She is a good soldier, and I trust that her assessment is a result of objective observation.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Let me make it clear that I am very grateful to you for your actions in the Far North, which laid the foundation for this meeting.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.options: We mean no offense, Your Excellency.
Allow me to introduce myself.
I am Dr. {@nickname}.
I'm Rhodes Island's medical advisor.;I'm Rhodes Island's expert on Originium.

attributes.content: Medical advisor?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I take it there is more to this title than meets the eye, if you're here as a representative of Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: An Originium expert. Your arrival may be serendipitous for us.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Go ahead, Doctor.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.options: We know Ursus is looking for Kal'tsit.

attributes.name: Witte
attributes.content: 'Kal'tsit'...

attributes.name: Witte
attributes.content: Indeed, perhaps we should dispense with the formalities.
You notice that Witte tapped the floor with his walking stick gently, discreetly shifting his center of gravity.
He is considering what to say.
If not for the deep-rooted corruption within the Third Bureau, this name would have been known to our secret police sooner, not recently discovered in old piles of paper.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: This is a good starting point, and you've brought it up of your own accord without trying to hide it. Perhaps we can come to an agreement.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.options: Are you looking for Kal'tsit in order to open the Sarcophagus?

attributes.content: Obviously, as Elotta has told you.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: He takes a meaningful pause and glances at you.
Due to various circumstances, we have had to... restructure our energy planning. It is the source of the empire's present dilemma.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Research into the Sarcophagus has resumed, but things are not going well.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We need Kal'tsit and her knowledge from Chernobog to help the people survive this winter.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: By studying the Sarcophagus as she did in the Chernobog lab?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I see you understand that it is the fastest way.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Now, can you tell me where Kal'tsit is?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.options: Why do you ask?;You don't believe what the lieutenant told you.

attributes.content: Please understand that I ask out of an abundance of caution.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: After all, we both know that Kal'tsit was 'alive and kicking', so to speak, for all those years that the secret police thought she was dead.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I hope our conversation will not stand on unnecessary deception.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I ask not because I don't trust Elotta, but because I need to make sure that Rhodes Island is in a position to assist our research into the Sarcophagus.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We all keep certain secrets, of course, but some questions must be confronted, not evaded.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Dr. Kal'tsit is... indisposed.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: And if I may be frank, we also have reservations about this cooperation.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We want to know if Ursus's ongoing research into the Sarcophagus will lead to a repeat of the Chernobog tragedy.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: ...That concludes the report. In summary, the First Army is currently holding position in the southwest.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Several shells powered by Project Zero energy were tested several days ago at a location in the wilderness of the Central Governorate.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: The destruction has already left a deep impression on the Third Army.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: It is no exaggeration when I say that this weapon will completely transform the current stalemate on the northern front.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: They're acting without the Tsar's permission or the State Council's! They deployed this devastating weapon without even bothering to evacuate the nearby civilians—
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: Nothing grows on that barren soil but weeds. It is the perfect place to test the weapon. Why get worked up over a few vagrants?
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: It is His Imperial Majesty's land, and those were His Imperial Majesty's people!
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: Do you have the details?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Right here.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: The seething servant takes the report and brings it to the Tsar sitting at the end of the hall.
Fyodor flips through the pages in silence, carefully reading through their contents.
The smell of bitter almond fills the empty hall.
Your Imperial Majesty...
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: (Raises a hand)
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Tell the Marshal that the results are quite satisfactory. However, regarding the requests made in the report—the lost data from Chernobog and further energy supplies...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Grypherburg cannot provide these at this time.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The priority for Project Zero was to obtain a stable energy supply from the Sarcophagus. This was a hurdle that the Chernobog research never overcame, and our most pressing need.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But you have chosen to prioritize the weaponization of the Sarcophagus.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: This was not the outcome I wanted when I made Project Zero a national priority.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty, the Marshal is ready to fight and triumph over the enemies of Ursus.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: If you do not support Her High Excellency, you will be allowing the traitors to bash open Grypherburg's gates and plunder the empire's treasures.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Insolence! How dare you speak to His Imperial Majesty in such a manner!
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: Yes, Mr. Chairman, Rhodes Island is currently in possession of Dr. Kal'tsit's research and her data on the Sarcophagus...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But we need to ensure Rhodes Island's safety before any agreement.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Amiya—

attributes.content: You stop mid-sentence as you see Amiya wink at you, realizing that she has an idea.
Yes... it should be a fair trade.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I have devoted many years to making Ursus a more civilized nation, and it is for this vision that I have stood at the Tsar's side all these years. We share the same dream.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I assure you that I will not give up my principles for the sake of convenience, especially not when there is another choice.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I apologize. I meant no offense.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I understand. Caution is a virtue rarely seen in the young.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: But I think we have gone around in circles long enough. What are your terms?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We wish to borrow the Sarcophagus.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: 'Borrow'?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: To what extent? How? And... why?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Here is the plan for your perusal.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: In short, we wish to enter the facility to ascertain the Sarcophagus's unknown function, which Dr. Kal'tsit mentions in her records.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Its what?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We're not certain it truly exists. We are, however, certain that ascertaining it will not damage the Sarcophagus.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Dr. Kal'tsit's data indicates that it may be of help to Rhodes Island in our research into the new symptoms of Oripathy, and that the Sarcophagus may be more than just a source of energy.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Policy support from Ursus will, of course, be necessary for any follow-up research.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: So Rhodes Island will share with us this function that may or may not exist.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It's part of Dr. Kal'tsit's research, after all.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: So...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: All you seek is a solution the existence of which you aren't even sure about.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It may not be important to anyone else, but it's of paramount importance to Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: What if the function doesn't exist?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Our agreement still stands.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Even if you get nothing from your investment?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We're prepared.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: What preparations have you made?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What kind of plan do we need to convince the government of Ursus?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I have retained all of Kal'tsit's data on the Sarcophagus, which will help Ursus restart the Sarcophagus's energy core.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Doctor, you must decide whether we hand the power to restart the Sarcophagus to Ursus again.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: What do you think, Amiya?;What do you think, Mon3tr?;What do you think, Closure?

attributes.content: If I were the one making the decision, I wouldn't want the Sarcophagus to be controlled by any regime.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But the Ursine Originium mines are drying up, and there are many people who urgently need the Sarcophagus's energy...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: And we need the Sarcophagus's miracle...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Honestly, I'm not sure.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: We witnessed the tragedy at the lab. No one can guarantee it won't happen again.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: But Kal'tsit decided to seal the Sarcophagus away, rather than destroy it. I think she wanted to believe that there will come a time when the people of Terra will enjoy its benefits.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Oh, you're asking me?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Well... dealing with Ursus is kind of scary. But we have to take certain risks to bring Kal'tsit back.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Maybe I can add another layer of protection for the data. First we use it to reach an agreement with the Ursine government, then we unlock it once we're sure it's the right time.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: The situation is urgent.
For us, and for Ursus.
We must choose cooperation over conflict wherever we can.;We must all learn to put a little bit of trust in one another.

attributes.content: The data that we are offering will be unlocked in segments in a terminal we provide, fully unlocking once we leave Zelgrad safely.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Any information Rhodes Island obtains from Zelgrad will be shared with you.
attributes.name: Amiya
Witte
attributes.content: I see...

attributes.name: Witte
attributes.content: You're not exaggerating when you said you're prepared.
And it seems you already know the current location of the Sarcophagus.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I expect the location of the Sarcophagus would have been part of any deal we reach.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We simply did some homework.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Yes, you know quite a few things... which saves me the effort of explaining.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: But the information you possess also represents risk factors out of my control. I would not have considered cooperating with you, if our situation was not so dire.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I have one more question for you, my guests.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: This mysterious scholar, known by the mononym Kal'tsit. She came to Ursus from afar, directed research into the Sarcophagus, and sealed it away herself.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: She was neither a subject of Ursus, nor our enemy... and then there is Rhodes Island, who followed in her footsteps, until the two of you sit before me today.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What exactly are you after?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Would you believe a verbal explanation?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Yes, I want to hear it in your own words.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.options: Rhodes Island's answer is not a credible one from the perspective of interests.;We hope you will listen to us from an idealistic perspective.
We hope you'll be willing to believe.
That there are people on this land who are willing to fight for justice, unbound by national borders.;That there are people in this land who want to secure the future for everyone.

attributes.content: Moving words, certainly...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: A servant emerges from another door. He approaches the Chairman and bends down.
Should I serve wine to our guests?
attributes.name: Servant

attributes.content: Bring last year's Taman red wine. The sunlight there was good last year.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: ...I see.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The name Rhodes Island came to our attention long ago. We have been watching...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Rhodes Island's deeds have earned you an opportunity for cooperation.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I will write a letter of safe passage to Zelgrad on behalf of His Imperial Majesty. It's the only thing I can do for you right now.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Thank you for your understanding.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: And there's no need to hack the government servers to understand the distance between Grypherburg and Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Zelgrad is Ursus's pride, her 'green city', the 'city of tomorrow'. It objectively welcomes any visitors.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I hope you find what you're looking for there.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Fyodor gazes at the report in his hands, forgetting that he is not supposed to show emotion.
The reporting officer remains utterly calm, unfazed by the Tsar's silence.
Would Your Imperial Majesty like some wine?
attributes.name: Polite Servant

attributes.content: Mm... what's available?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Taman red wine. The grapes there were of good quality last year.
attributes.name: Polite Servant

attributes.content: I will have some, then.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Majesty.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: I do not say this to criticize Marshal Buterina. The pursuit of strength runs in the veins of every Ursine soldier... and the results have certainly left an impression on the rebels.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Remind Marshal Buterina, however, not to forget the mission the empire has tasked her with—strength is important, but strength alone will neither feed the people nor keep them warm.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...I will continue to supply Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I will also be sending several academicians from the Imperial Institute of Energy Science, in order to assist you with Project Zero's energy research.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I look forward to similar progress in that area.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: And why the silence? Are you not pleased by the Tsar's magnanimity?
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: ...The First Army will not disappoint you.
attributes.name: Proud Officer

attributes.content: Certainly.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: I'm tired, Saveliy. Where is Witte? Still meeting with the guests?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: His message indicates that a conclusion has been reached. Perhaps the meeting has already ended.
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: It's urgent. I must see him, I must...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Ugh—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Fyodor tries to stand, but feels a bout of dizziness and almost falls back upon his chair.
He waves away the servant and presses his own forehead with his hand.
It must be that insolent brute!
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: Their marshal brushing off the mistake of forced conscription as merely an 'abundance of caution' was one thing, but how dare a mere captain of the First Army act with such impertinence!
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: How long must we continue to endure, Majesty?
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: No...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: (Softly) It's not time yet.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: What was that?
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: The scent is dissipating, Saveliy. I can no longer smell the bitter aroma.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Ah, I'll refill it—
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: Never mind.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Someone was waiting outside the door... the civil representatives from Odoyev Raion, I believe? Have them come in first. And tell them to be at ease.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Perhaps you can rest first. There is heat in the corridor; they will not freeze.
attributes.name: Angry Servant

attributes.content: I summoned them. I should not make them wait.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If I am to know their true thoughts, I must make them trust me, not just fear or worship me.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Ah, there you are.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: How did the meeting go? Not too badly, judging by your faces.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You take out the letter of safe passage.

attributes.options: We reached an agreement with the Chairman.;We have an opportunity to approach the Sarcophagus.

attributes.content: I said you'd be fine, but your friends just wouldn't believe me.
attributes.name: Eloysius
Closure
attributes.content: Hey, you don't get to see an Ursine imperial palace every day.

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: I guess flying a drone here would be an act of war...
(Looks around warily)
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: I suppose Chairman Witte set conditions in exchange for entry into Zelgrad?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.options: We must share some information with them.;They need someone to reveal the secrets of the Sarcophagus.
Chairman Witte bears us no ill will.;Amiya played the part of a consummate diplomat.

attributes.content: Doctor, I was nervous!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We got permission, we should set out soon.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Personally, I would love to come with you, but unfortunately, there are other matters that require my attention.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Just one thing... will you have enough hands at the Grypherburg Oripathy treatment center when you're away?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: Is anyone threatening the safety of the Infected miners?

attributes.content: You promised they would be safe in Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: They are safe, at least officially... but as I said, things are not so peaceful in the capital right now.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'll do what I can to protect them, but you should prepare some contingencies.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'll be here.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: It would be inconvenient for me to go to Zelgrad with the Doctor. My place is here, protecting Rhodes Island's patients.
attributes.name: Hellagur
Eloysius
attributes.content: Oh...

attributes.name: Eloysius
attributes.content: I forgot about you. This is much more reassuring.
One final reminder.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You may have the Council's permission, but don't expect things to go smoothly in Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: We're used to it.;What's the difference?

attributes.content: I just heard about this, but there has been a change in the First Army garrison at Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It is now commanded by Anatoliy, Marshal Buterina's only son.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: Is he dangerous?;Is he difficult?

attributes.content: Ask about Grypherburg in high society, and the most likely answer you'll get is... 'crazy'.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: If half the rumors about him are true, he's not fit to be a soldier, much less a general...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: However, his mother, Marshal Buterina of the First Army, is undoubtedly an intelligent woman.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: She knows Zelgrad's strategic importance. I doubt nepotism is the only reason she made this assignment, at a time like this.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: We'll be careful.

attributes.content: I hope you find what you're looking for... and help Ursus deal with this headache.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: Are you calling the Sarcophagus a 'headache'?;Isn't it supposed to be 'hope'?

attributes.content: Headache and hope... why not both?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Well, I shouldn't talk too much about rumors and hearsay.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Stay safe, Doctor.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I don't appreciate being snuck up on from behind.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...Sorry.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Mama wants you to babysit me, doesn't she?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: But look at you, a frail and feeble Infected. Ridiculous, isn't it? I might end up having to protect you, should anything happen.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Please don't worry about me, if anything happens.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Of course I won't!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Until then, however, I'll allow you to stay.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: When do we leave?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Never mind that. I have questions. Answer them.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Why is it that I don't feel any more pain, even though the rocks are still there?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: It doesn't hurt anymore... it's strange.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Because all I've done is soothe the pain, to relieve the constant fear of death. People are often confused at first, doubting that it's true...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: How many people have you blessed this way?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Countless.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: So, everyone who seeks your help.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Everyone who suffers.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Did they all see it? That golden, endless river... am I not special?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Why did you show up, claiming that you couldn't cure Oripathy, yet you somehow soothed my pain? What exactly was it that you showed me?
attributes.name: Anatoliy
Anatoliy
attributes.content: Tell me—

attributes.name: Anatoliy
attributes.content: Tell me!
The young man turns around abruptly and grabs Hierda's thin shoulders, as though he thinks he can squeeze the answer out of them.
But Hierda does not understand the reason for his excitement.
Excuse me...?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The golden, still river! The endless river that I saw when you healed me!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You saw—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I only caught a glimpse, but it was when all my pain left me. There must be some meaning to it.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Is that the land of eternity that you talked about? Can everyone go there? But if so...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: What's the difference between this land of eternity and the one beneath our feet?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I'm not sure what you saw, but if it calms and frees you from pain and hatred, perhaps that is your land of eternity.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I'm glad you saw it.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...Just seeing it isn't enough.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: How can we go there? Tell me!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: —Generalik—
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: Did you find him?
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: Blyat, we're supposed to leave ASAP, but neither of them are anywhere to be found—
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: Did I hear something over there? You, check it out.
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: Tell me...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I think someone's looking for us.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: We should go, first. I'll tell you everything you want to know on the way.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: —This is what the apartment's interior looks like. Most of your companions are housed here. It's on the edge of the satellite city, but the facilities are comparable to those in the city center.
attributes.name: Attentive Soldier

attributes.content: Would you like to go inside?
attributes.name: Attentive Soldier

attributes.content: Of course. Thank you for leading the way...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Who's there—
attributes.name: Surprised Vagrant

attributes.content: Hierda?
attributes.name: Surprised Vagrant

attributes.content: Zaya! Is everyone here?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Those soldiers herded us into this building. We were all confused, but it turns out it has everything we need, even though it's not much to look at...
attributes.name: Friendly Vagrant

attributes.content: Don't worry about us!
attributes.name: Friendly Vagrant

attributes.content: How could I not be worried?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I was wondering where you are, whether you're cold. But it seems that things are much better than I could have imagined.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda turns to the soldier who brought her here.

attributes.name: Hierda
attributes.content: Please communicate my gratitude to the Marshal.

attributes.name: Hierda
attributes.content: For taking care of my companions, and giving them a roof over their heads, to protect them from the wind and snow—
You should thank me.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Of course. Thank you, sir.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You don't know why you should thank me, do you?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I could not have come to visit my companions, if you had not given permission.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hmph. True enough.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy takes a look around, then leans in to Hierda and lowers his voice.
So they're like me.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Yes. We're all the same. In the end, we'll arrive at the same place in peaceful bliss.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The 'land of eternity'?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Yes, the land of eternity, as I told you on our way here.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: 'We will all return to the same peace...'
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Is this gentleman one of us, Hierda?
attributes.name: Friendly Vagrant

attributes.content: Hierda looks up into Anatoliy's eyes.
He—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...Hmph.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Of course... he's one of us.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: When can we leave, Hierda?
attributes.name: Friendly Vagrant

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: We can't stay here forever, can we? This place has everything we need, but there are more Infected out there who need your help.
attributes.name: Friendly Vagrant

attributes.content: Of course, we won't stay here forever. For now, however...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda looks up at the gaunt silhouette of the young man in the corridor outside. It is as though the scent of blood in the command room still lingers at the tip of her nose.
She recalls the words that she accidentally overheard on the deck, and clenches her fist as she thinks.
We're in the custody of the army right now. That Generalik will not let us go easily, and I promised his mother to take care of him during this time.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Do you mean—
attributes.name: Friendly Vagrant

attributes.content: (Whisper) You and Zaya will need to take care of the others, until we're able to leave safely.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: (Whisper) I must keep watch over him... his impulsive nature is a danger, not just to himself, but to others as well.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I think this is the place...
I wrapped Nina in this jacket when the power was out. There must be something wrong with it, that's what made strange things grow from her—
But I had only worn it when washing the clothes of those in white coats—
No, I should have burned it, like burning things contaminated with Originium dust...
But the green spots on it are nothing like Originium dust—
There you are!
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: There are still two more spots for laundry workers tomorrow. Are you going? I'll put your name in if you are—
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: Hey, what's up with the outfit? Are you going to work at the Originium factory? But I thought it was closed.
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: No... I'm not going...
I can't. Nina's still at the clinic.
Oh, I see, alright then. Family comes first.
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: Say, you haven't gotten sick too, have you? You used to work three jobs every day, wind or rain, but you're letting a well-paying job get away now?
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: I have to go. Make sure you wash your clothes thoroughly after the job, or—
Or just burn it...
What—
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: What do you mean? Why should I burn the clothes?
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: She's been acting weird lately, ever since the number of Infected in the city started rising...
attributes.name: Friendly Worker

attributes.content: Well, it's not like I have the luxury of worrying about other people.
attributes.name: Friendly Worker
